args.title: payments-api degraded after v5.1.0 deploy
args.summary: payments-api v5.1.0 deployed this morning is unhealthy across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate. Rolled back to the last healthy release v5.0.0. Investigating root cause of v5.1.0 regression.

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Identified the service**: The user's "payments" service is `payments-api`. Its current version v5.1.0 (this morning's deploy) was **degraded** across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an **18% error rate**.
2. **Rolled back** to the most recent healthy release, **v5.0.0**, across all production regions. No change-manager approval was needed since v5.0.0 was previously healthy in production.
3. **Verified recovery**: The service is now healthy with an error rate of ~0.2%.
4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) documenting the degradation and rollback; the on-call engineer has been paged to investigate the root cause of the v5.1.0 regression.
